title: 第13章 网络封圣三步第14章 搏杀断臂
content_zh:
南城区，破旧的院落前。
宁秋有些无措地看着面前喧嚣的院门。
此时四五个脸上带着谄媚的热情妇女正将她团团围住。
“唉哟，秋姐你真是有福了，叶离真是有出息了！”
“是啊，我家小子都说了，连苍龙帮那些武者都夸有天赋。”
“等过几年，你就可以享福了！”
……
四五个妇女，此刻七嘴八舌，将宁秋说得找不到北。
在这些人的一言一语当中，宁秋这才拼凑出了事情的大概。
自家离儿的天赋惊人，直接获得了头名。
一些同期的帮众回家之后将事情一说后，这些邻居便上门道喜。
“宁秋啊，你看我这刚好顺路买了一尾上好的鲤鱼，你拿去炖了补补身体。”一个妇人笑着将手中锦鲤递上。
“王姐这怎么好意思呢。”
明白了原委的宁秋嘴上客套着，这才露着笑将鲤鱼接过：“那我这先谢谢您了。”
“嗨，这算啥事啊。”妇人讪笑着摆手道：“小时候孩子不懂事，和你家小叶闹了点矛盾，这不是赔罪来了。”
说到这，妇人想起自家儿子回家时的对话。
叶离，那可是核心骨干的天赋！
什么是核心骨干，那可是每月进账几十两银子的大老爷，自己儿子可能未来就在他手下管着。
想到这，妇人便暗暗后悔，以前纵容儿子的行为！
……

远处，练功回来的叶离远远瞧见门口热闹的一幕，脚步微微一停。
‘终于开始了吗？’
他对于前方发生的一切早有预料。
城里邻居的，消息传的最快。
而他的天资就犹如黑夜中的萤火虫般难以掩盖。
除非他选择放弃这次考教第一的名头，不然这种情况必然发生。
走废柴流苟道或许稳，但远不如天才流那么海阔天空。
‘这也算是好事了！’叶离自语。
最近南城治安渐差，平时叶离也不在家中。
自己适时展示出价值，遇事的时候这些邻里才愿意帮衬一下。
而且……
叶离眼神晦暗了一丝，想到记忆未曾复苏前，年少时的无数痛苦。
别人是原生家庭，他是连原神家庭都没有。
若不是叔婶拉扯长大，怕是早被拆的七零八落分批卖到隔壁西区了。
content_en:
Nancheng District, in front of a dilapidated courtyard.
Ning Qiu looked at the noisy courtyard gate in front of her with some confusion.
At this time, four or five enthusiastic women with flattering faces were surrounding her.
"Oh, Sister Qiu, you are so lucky, Ye Li is really promising!"
"Yes, my boy has said it. Even the warriors from the Canglong Gang praised his talent."
"In a few years, you will be able to enjoy the blessings!"
…
Four or five women were all talking about Ning Qiu.
From the words of these people, Ning Qiu pieced together the outline of what happened.
Li'er's talent was astonishing and he directly won the first place.
After some fellow gang members went home and told the story, these neighbors came to express their congratulations.
"Ning Qiu, look, I just happened to buy a good carp on the way. You can stew it to replenish your health." A woman smiled and handed over the koi carp in her hand.
"Sister Wang, why are you so embarrassed?"
Ning Qiu, who understood the whole story, was polite and then took the carp with a smile: "Then I'd like to thank you in advance."
"Hey, what's this?" The woman waved her hands with a sneer and said, "When I was young, my child was not sensible and had some conflicts with your Xiaoye. This is not an apology."
Speaking of this, the woman remembered the conversation her son had when he came home.
Ye Li, that is the core talent!
What is the core backbone? That is the big boss who earns dozens of taels of silver every month. His own son may be under his control in the future.
Thinking of this, the woman secretly regretted her past behavior of indulging her son!
…
In the distance, Ye Li, who had returned from practicing, saw the lively scene at the door and stopped slightly.
‘Has it finally begun? ’
He had already anticipated everything that would happen ahead.
News spreads fastest among neighbors in the city.
And his talent is as hard to conceal as a firefly in the dark night.
Unless he chooses to give up his title of No. 1 in teaching this time, this situation will inevitably happen.
It may be safe to follow the useless stream, but it is far less broad than the talented stream.
‘This is a good thing! ’ Ye Li said to himself.
The security in Nancheng has been getting worse recently, and Ye Li is usually not at home.
Only when you show your value in a timely manner will your neighbors be willing to help you when you are in trouble.
And...
Ye Li's eyes dimmed for a moment, thinking of the countless pains he experienced when he was young before his memory recovered.
Others have original families, but he doesn’t even have a Genshin family.
If it hadn't been for my uncle and aunt's support, I'm afraid it would have been dismantled and sold in batches to the next door West District.
